cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Committee,

I am a computer engineer and lecturer who has moved research ideas into real systems for several years. At Mersin University I built an NLP evaluation pipeline that runs on heterogeneous servers, integrated it with a web service, and kept it reliable for clinical users. The project required profiling code, writing tests, and monitoring performance, which matches the end-to-end responsibility you describe for the Scheduler.

My work with COST projects on AI-driven dental age estimation and brain-cancer modelling involved handling GPU clusters, writing Python and PyTorch code, and creating reproducible benchmarking pipelines. I also led a department where I introduced CI, code reviews and clear ticket specifications, so my designs are easy for others to follow.

Beyond research, I co-founded a startup and a technology centre, where I built AI-enabled products that run on customer hardware. Those experiences taught me to balance accuracy, latency and cost, and to add guardrails that keep services stable when the underlying infrastructure changes.

I look forward to bringing this blend of research depth and production discipline to Turba Labs. Thank you for considering my application.

Best regards,
Anıl Kuş
